name: Magus Opus
source:
A game utilizing the most famous personality test in the world, the Keirsey/Myers-briggs Temperament Sorter. You play a young person new to Magehood and where the player’s choices will lead to what kind of mage they will become. 

[Edited from [url=http://lemmasoft.renai.us/forums/viewtopic.php?f=11&t=19491]Lemma Soft Forums[/url]]
translation:
该游戏利用了世界上最著名的性格测试——Keirsey/Myers-briggs气质分类器。你扮演一个刚接触法师的年轻人，玩家的选择将导致他们成为什么样的法师。

[编辑自[url=http://lemmasoft.renai.us/forums/viewtopic.php?f=11&t=19491]引理软论坛[/url]]
